title: Dan Sheehan discredited through stigma

tellings.quote: there was an attempt to discredit him through stigma because of his interest in the iran contra matter right with the christic institute and so i think he was fed wrong information probably so that he'd swing at a bad pitch

plain: A researcher named Eric Weinstein, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2022, says that a man named Dan Sheehan was targeted in the late 1980s because of his work, with a group called the Christic Institute, on the Iran-Contra affair, a US political scandal of that decade. Weinstein thinks Sheehan was probably fed false information so that he would chase it and be discredited by the stigma. If true, it would mean feeding people bad UFO-type stories can be used to ruin them.
